KARTHIKEYAN S

Email: karthi512251@gmail.com

Contact No: +91 8870880462 /

9976517165

CAREER OBJECTIVE

Data Governance Analyst with 3.5 years of hands-on experience in the Collibra Data Intelligence platform, specializing in Metadata Management, Data Catalog, Data Profiling, and Data Lineage and Data Quality. Seeking a challenging role in leveraging expertise in data governance and contributing to enterprise-wide data management initiatives.

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

7.7 years of overall IT experience in Banking and Finance domain, including 3.5 years of experience in Financial Domain specializing in Collibra Data Governance, with strong expertise in Data Governance, Metadata Management, Data Quality, Data Catalog and Data Lineage.

4.2 years of experience in providing end-to-end Application Support and ensuring stable, high-quality operations for business-critical systems.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Cognizant Technology Solutions Analyst, Client: S&P Global

Coimbatore December 2022 - Present

Designed, developed, and maintained the Collibra Data Catalog to improve enterprise- wide data discoverability, accessibility, and trust for business users.

Performed automated metadata ingestion through Collibra EDGE, ensuring continuous synchronization and up-to-date metadata across all integrated data sources.

Automated schema refresh cycles and profiling schedules to streamline data governance processes.

Created and maintained metadata attributes, asset relationships and mapping between business domains for better lineage and traceability.

Created and managed Data Dictionary and Business Glossary assets, standardizing definitions and improving alignment between technical teams and business stakeholders.

Collaborated with cross functional teams including IT, Data Owners, Stewards, and Business Teams to validate metadata completeness, accuracy, and classification outputs, ensuring compliance with governance standards.

Managed and executed adaptive and custom Data Quality rules for critical datasets such as Bonds and Rebalance, ensuring adherence to data standards and regulatory expectations.

Monitored DQ scores, diagnosed failing metrics, and refined DQ rules as needed , working closely with Business and Source System teams to drive root-cause analysis and long-term data quality improvements. Implemented and managed Data Quality rules to proactively monitor, measure, and improve data accuracy and reliability.



Careernet Technologies Senior Production Support Analyst

Coimbatore January 2022 - December 2022

Monitored application alerts and proactively engaged L2 and Development teams to ensure timely incident resolution and minimize production impact.

Supported and coordinated production deployments, AWS EC2 server patching, database migrations, PROD/DR failovers, and scheduled change activities, ensuring seamless and compliant execution.

Performed regular application health checks, service validations, and Cron job monitoring to maintain system stability and early detection of issues.

Conducted log analysis using Datadog and AWS CloudWatch, identifying root causes, performance bottlenecks, and application anomalies.

Experienced in ITIL-based Incident, Problem, and Change Management processes, driving efficient resolution and root-cause analysis in high-availability environments. • Designed and developed a Power BI dashboard providing monthly AWS spending across key services (EC2, S3, RDS, etc.), enabling leadership and infrastructure teams to identify cost trends and optimize cloud usage Hyderabad

Virtusa

September 2019 - January 2022

Client: Citi Bank

Managed and supported the Flexcube Core Banking application across 50+ EMEA countries, ensuring high availability and seamless banking operations.

Monitored EOD batch processes, file transfers (incoming/outgoing), system performance metrics (CPU/Disk), and TIBCO queues to maintain daily operations. • Utilized SQL, UNIX commands, and log analysis to troubleshoot application issues,

perform data validation, and support incident resolution.

Scheduled, monitored, and maintained critical batch jobs using CA Autosys, ensuring timely execution and dependency management.

Coordinated troubleshooting, deployments, and issue resolution with cross-functional teams, ensuring minimal downtime and efficient release management.

Cognizant Technology Solutions Process Executive Client: CoreLogic

Coimbatore

August 2018 - June 2019

Worked as a Process Executive for a leading Mortgage Servicing firm, supporting day-to-day operational activities and customer data processing.

Entered and validated customer information in internal portals and ensured accurate and timely uploads to the client platform, maintaining high data quality.

SKILL:

Data Governance & Platforms: Collibra (Data Catalog, Metadata Ingestion, Data Profiling, Data Lineage, Business Glossary, Data Quality), Databricks (Data Governance, Unity Catalog).

Data Visualization & Analytics: Power BI (Dashboard Design) • Database & OS: SQL, Unix • Cloud & Monitoring: AWS, Datadog, Jenkins, Autosys • ITSM Tools: ServiceNow, Incident/Problem/Change Management.

CERTIFICATION:

Collibra Data Steward Certification • Collibra Solution Architect Certification

AWARDS & ACHIEVEMENTS:

Awarded as Best Performer of the month for maintaining high production. • Awarded as Ace of Rookies for learning concepts to execution. • Awarded for exemplary focus on quality and performance excellence.

ACADEMIC BACKGROUND:

B.Sc. Information Technology - Nehru Arts and Science College, Coimbatore| 2018 | 74.5%

DECLARATION:

I hereby declare that the particulars given by me are true and correct to the best of my knowledge and belief.

Karthikeyan S
